title: Encoding a Boolean function as a proof
statement: For every natural number $N$ and every function $f:\{ -1,1\}^N\to\{ -1,1\}$, encode its values as Booleans indexed by the $2^N$ points of the sign cube, then decode that Boolean function on the sign cube. The resulting function is $f$.
hypotheses_covered: Function from the $N$-dimensional sign cube to the sign set
